about: The record videos on the Performance page (`beta/performance.html`): the site playing a complete game in real time, start to victory.
Operator 2026-11-21: "performance should be a page ... we want the civvis performance charts there. fastest game video."
The video with the fewest `seconds` is the page's video; the rest are listed under it as the earlier records. A new record is a line added here.

`video` is the YouTube address, `seconds` the time the video shows a game played in, `time` that time as the video's title words it, `posted` the day it went up, `title` its title without the channel's prefix.
They are the videos of the channel's playlist of self-play performance demos that show one complete game: https://www.youtube.com/playlist?list=PLPI7k77hCAR4
